defensibility.rationale: Established vendors have large behavioral datasets. A new entrant has few sessions (about 900,000 claimed) and no named customers.

market_need_then: Analysts say passkeys push attackers toward session hijacking, raising value of continuous checks, and AI agents acting for users create new authorization questions. Market size estimates are around $3 to 4 billion for 2026.
